candidates.title: York Bowen: Fantasia for Four Violas in E minor, Op. 41, No. 1
candidates.description:
English composer York Bowen wrote Fantasia for Four Violas in 1907 as a project for his friend Lionel Tertis—a fellow violist and colleague at the Royal Academy of Music—to perform with students. However, rather than sounding like a musical lecture from teacher to pupil, Bowen's composition feels more like a conversation among peers. His Fantasia captures both wistfulness and driving energy with “a harmonic language and idiom peculiarly his own” (Gramophone). Read more about the piece at https://www.laphil.com/musicdb/pieces/7619/fantasia-for-four-violas-in-e-minor-op-41-no-1.

Violists Ben Ullery, Minor L. Wetzel, Michael Larco, and Hui Liu of the Los Angeles Philharmonic perform a studio rendition of Bowen’s colorful fantasy piece. Recorded at Walt Disney Concert Hall in November 2025.
